featured_reviews.name: Keval Gemani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience. I ordered a Chocolate Box and a Brownie Box from Theobroma, and both boxes arrived filled with dead red ants. Not a few — the desserts were literally infested.

This is disgusting and dangerous, showing a complete lack of hygiene and quality control. For a brand that claims to be premium, this is shocking negligence. I can’t imagine how such items were even allowed to leave their kitchen.

Yes, they refunded the order after I complained — but no amount of money erases the horror of opening a dessert box crawling with ants. A refund doesn’t fix a broken hygiene system.

This incident has completely destroyed my trust in Theobroma. I won’t be ordering again, and I’d strongly urge the brand to take serious action to ensure such contamination never happens again.

Utterly disappointed, disgusted, and furious.

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to report a serious food safety issue regarding products purchased from your outlet.

On 26th April 2026 at around 1:00 PM, I purchased two pastries and mini pizza from your shop. After reaching home, I served the pastry to my wife and my 3.5-year-old daughter. My daughter ate approximately half of the pastry, and I consumed the remaining portion.

While eating, I discovered a small, sharp object inside the pastry, resembling the tip of a needle. When I removed it from my mouth, it caused a deep cut on my finger and led to bleeding. The object was extremely sharp and potentially dangerous.

This incident is very alarming. If this object had been accidentally swallowed by me or, more seriously, by my young daughter, it could have resulted in severe internal injury or bleeding. The situation left me shocked for several hours.

Considering that your brand claims to follow strict quality standards such as GMP, FSSAI, and ISO certifications, this kind of lapse is completely unacceptable. Such an incident raises serious concerns about your food safety and quality control processes.

In my opinion, the object could be a metallic fragment, possibly from machinery or equipment used during production. However, a proper investigation is required to determine the exact cause.

I request you to:

Immediately investigate this incident
Identify the root cause
Take strict corrective actions to prevent recurrence
Provide a written explanation and assurance regarding product safety

Please treat this matter with utmost urgency, as it involves consumer safety, especially that of a child.

I look forward to your prompt response
